body: Operator report: staging keeps behaving like production. We set APP_PORT=9090 and APP_DEBUG=true in the staging environment, but the service still binds the production port with debug off — app/config.py load_config() is documented to let APP_* environment overrides win over the built-in DEFAULTS, yet the effective config always comes back as the defaults. env_overrides() translates the variables correctly (its tests pass); the merge in load_config() applies the precedence backwards. Fix load_config() so environment overrides win, defaults fill in the rest, and unknown variables are ignored. Acceptance: load_config({'APP_PORT': '9090'}) returns port 9090 with the other defaults intact; load_config({}) still returns exactly DEFAULTS; existing tests still pass.
title: Config loader silently ignores environment overrides
